layout_and_spacing.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (Technical Look). Expose the skeleton. Remove soft shadows. Apply 1px sharp borders. Utilize 'border-collapse' style structures for metrics.

components.buttons: Flat, sharp edges (rounded-none). Primary CTA: bg-[#002FA7] text-white hover:bg-[#002480]. Secondary/Outline: border-2 border-slate-900 text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100.
components.cards: Strictly flat. bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-none shadow-none. Content padding MUST be generous (p-6 or p-8).
components.navigation: Solid white sticky top-nav with a 1px solid border-b border-slate-200. Left: Sharp text logo. Right: Navigation links (no hamburger on desktop) + User Avatar.
components.tables: Dense, crisp data tables. Left-aligned for text, right-aligned for all MXN currency metrics. Subtly tinted row headers (bg-slate-50).
components.charts: Shadcn Charts (Recharts). Use purely functional colors: Emerald for Income, Red for Expenses. Line charts for Net Balance trends.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Select, Calendar (for dates), and Inputs. No native inputs. Square borders (rounded-none).

motion_and_interactions.hover: Transition background and border colors (duration-200 ease-in-out). Text color explicitly defined on hover.
motion_and_interactions.focus: High-contrast focus rings: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-950 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:outline-none.
motion_and_interactions.active: Crisp scale down (scale-[0.98]) to simulate physical key press.

icons.style: Use regular or bold weights for high legibility.

testing.requirements: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='metric-total-income', data-testid='nav-dashboard').

auth_backgrounds.description: Abstract gray architecture, use as the left-side structural imagery on the split-screen login.

media.rules: NEVER use placeholder services (dummyimage/via.placeholder). Rely strictly on these provided URLs.

page_specific_instructions.dashboard_summary: First row must display critical metrics: Total Income, Total Expenses, Net Balance, Cash/Transfer. Use massive typography (text-4xl) for values. Currency format: MXN.
page_specific_instructions.projects_view: Table format showing Project Name, Status (Completed/In Progress badge), Start/End Date, Income, Expenses, and Net Margin. Allow filtering by Partner.
page_specific_instructions.income_expenses_log: Detailed ledger. Must include type (Cash vs Transfer) with a clear visual icon distinction. Indicate which partner owns the debt/made the payment. Use Shadcn DatePicker and Select for inputs.
page_specific_instructions.partner_portal: A dedicated high-contrast module calculating 33.33% of the Net Balance, minus any dividends they have already withdrawn. Show 'Available to Collect' in a striking, dominant widget.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast). Strip all soft shadows (`shadow-sm`, `shadow-md`) from Shadcn components. Override CSS variables for `--radius` to `0rem` in `index.css`. All interactive elements must have semantic `data-testid` tags. Implement font families correctly in Tailwind config and load them via external stylesheets or Next/Vite head. The design must feel hyper-functional, precise, and objective, serving as a financial truth-source for the partners.
